A Small Room with Big Ambitions
Review by Nathan Puckett — 4 out of 5 stars
The Juniper Table, opened just this spring on Lowell Road, is the work of Imogen Fontaine, formerly head pastry chef at a celebrated city restaurant.
The dining room, redesigned by Helena Lawson, seats barely thirty and feels warm rather than crowded. --[1]-- Soft lighting and reclaimed wood give the small space real character. --[2]--
The savory menu is short but confident. Vegetables and herbs arrive each morning from Wickham Farm, a few miles away, and the kitchen shapes its dishes around whatever is delivered. --[3]-- The lemon tart, layered with impossibly thin pastry, is reason enough to book a table, and the warm chocolate custard is nearly its equal. --[4]--
For a room this small and this new, the cooking is remarkably assured, and I left already planning my return.
The Juniper Table, Lowell Road
Open Thursday through Sunday, from 5 p.m. to 10 p.m.
Reservations are strongly advised, as seating is limited.

Practice News
Booking Your Visits Online
Nobody enjoys waiting on hold at eight in the morning, yet that is exactly when our telephone lines are busiest. To help, Pennington Veterinary Clinic has opened a booking page on its website, which lets you book, move, or cancel a visit yourself at any hour. The page has been open for testing since February 24.
From March 2, the page accepts new bookings for routine health checks and vaccinations. Until March 16, a change to a visit already booked must be made by telephone. From that date, the page handles changes and cancellations as well. Bookings for dental work and other planned treatment follow on April 6. A visit for an animal that must be seen the same day will never be booked on the page, so please telephone the front desk.
If you use the new page, please rate each step on the short feedback form in our client area.
Miriam Lombardo
